# Part I {#sec-part1}

Part I has three chapters, moving from basics to data wrangling to data visualization. Beginners are advised to read them in sequence. [Chapter 1](@sec-01-basic-r) discusses R objects and operations that act on these objects, including descriptive statistical functions. \[Chapter 2\](@sec-02-data-wrangling) deals with data wrangling - the process of acquiring, selecting, and organizing data stored in a spreadsheet-like format. Both base R and `tidyverse` data wrangling functions will be discussed. \[Chapter 3\](@sec-03-data-visualization) focuses on data visualization. A picture is worth a thousand words. The chapter offers guidelines for choosing the most suitable graph based on the intended message and the data's properties. Both base R and `ggplot2` graphical systems will be discussed.

If R is new to you or you don't have access to RStudio, start with \[Chapter 6\](@sec-06-r-rstudio) and then jump back to \[Chapter 1\](@sec-01-basic-r).
